Produktinfo
The test stand BS 61 II is used as aditional equipment for analog HP, HP Digital or digital HPE III Basic. With the support of the test stand, the user's influence on the measurement results is reduced. 
The test stand BS 61 II is the ideal expansion of Bareiss handheld hardness testers, as it expands the range of applications. In combination, the handheld hardness tester can be used not only mobile but also stationary, for example, in the laboratory.
Video
Key Features 
Expansion of the application area of your handheld hardness tester 
With the manual test stand BS 61 II, your hardness tester can be used not only mobile but also as a tabletop unit in the laboratory or production.

Hardness testing conforming to standards 
With the BS 61 II, you ensure that all normative requirements such as constant lowering speed, defined contact pressure, and correct, vertical placement of the hardness tester for hardness testing are met.

Traceability
Traceability refers to the ability to monitor the origin, progress and history of our products, calibrations, processes, or measurements. This means that all steps and parameters that contribute to the creation of our products must be documented and traceable. 
Traceability ensures the transparency, integrity and reliability of data and enables the checking of quality standards. It plays a crucial role in error detection, quality control and ensuring compliance with legal requirements and our quality standards. 
DAkkS accredited Service
DAkkS Accredited Service 
Since 1996, Bareiss Prüfgerätebau GmbH has been recognized as a DAkkS-accredited calibration laboratory, standing for the highest quality and precision. Our calibrations comply with international standards according to DIN EN ISO/IEC 17025:2018, ensuring reliable and intentionally comparable measurement results. 
Take advantage of our service offerings: 
DAkkS-accredited laboratory since 1996 – Calibrations meeting the highest requirements and global standards.  
Calibration reminders – We automatically remind you of your next calibration.  
Service packages – Accredited calibration including maintenance and repair at a fixed price. Everything from a single source. 
Trust Bareiss for reliable calibrations and accurate measurement results.
Benefit from our experience as a manufacturer and accredited calibration laboratory.

Bareiss recommendation: Laboratory conditions according to DIN ISO 23529
